metadata.description: Azure Terraform MCP monitoring: an audit workbook, an e-mail action group and log alert rules on the server's structured logs. Deployed by Deploy-AzureTerraformMcp.ps1 -EnableMonitoring. Not validated against a live tenant.
Resource ID of the Log Analytics workspace the Container Apps environment logs to.

content.json:
## Azure Terraform MCP - audit
Who asked the agent for what, what was blocked, what changed in Azure. Source: structured JSON lines the server writes to stdout (table `ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL`).

items.name: Tool calls per user and outcome

content.title: Tool calls per user and outcome
content.query:
ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL | where Log_s has "azure-terraform-mcp" | extend e = parse_json(Log_s) | where tostring(e.app) == "azure-terraform-mcp"
| where tostring(e.type) == "audit" | summarize calls = count() by user = tostring(e.user), outcome = tostring(e.outcome) | order by calls desc

content.title: Tool calls over time
content.query:
ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL | where Log_s has "azure-terraform-mcp" | extend e = parse_json(Log_s) | where tostring(e.app) == "azure-terraform-mcp"
| where tostring(e.type) == "audit" | summarize calls = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h), tool = tostring(e.tool)

items.name: Applies and destroys (who planned, approved, applied)

content.title: Applies and destroys (who planned, approved, applied)
content.query:
ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL | where Log_s has "azure-terraform-mcp" | extend e = parse_json(Log_s) | where tostring(e.app) == "azure-terraform-mcp"
| where tostring(e.type) == "apply" | project TimeGenerated, environment = tostring(e.environment), deployment = tostring(e.deployment), destroy = tobool(e.destroy), outcome = tostring(e.outcome), applied_by = tostring(e.user), planned_by = tostring(e.planned_by), approved_by = tostring(e.approved_by), origin = tostring(e.origin), plan_id = tostring(e.plan_id) | order by TimeGenerated desc

content.title: Plans blocked by policy
content.query:
ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL | where Log_s has "azure-terraform-mcp" | extend e = parse_json(Log_s) | where tostring(e.app) == "azure-terraform-mcp"
| where tostring(e.type) == "plan" and tobool(e.policy_allowed) == false | project TimeGenerated, user = tostring(e.user), environment = tostring(e.environment), deployment = tostring(e.deployment), rules = tostring(e.policy_violations), risk = tostring(e.risk) | order by TimeGenerated desc

content.title: Denied and failed tool calls
content.query:
ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL | where Log_s has "azure-terraform-mcp" | extend e = parse_json(Log_s) | where tostring(e.app) == "azure-terraform-mcp"
| where tostring(e.type) == "audit" and tostring(e.outcome) != "ok" | project TimeGenerated, user = tostring(e.user), tool = tostring(e.tool), outcome = tostring(e.outcome), error = tostring(e.error), args = tostring(e.args) | order by TimeGenerated desc

content.title: Approvals
content.query:
ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL | where Log_s has "azure-terraform-mcp" | extend e = parse_json(Log_s) | where tostring(e.app) == "azure-terraform-mcp"
| where tostring(e.type) in ("approval_requested", "approval_decided") | project TimeGenerated, event = tostring(e.type), decision = tostring(e.decision), by = tostring(e.user), requested_by = tostring(e.requested_by), environment = tostring(e.environment), deployment = tostring(e.deployment), plan_id = tostring(e.plan_id) | order by TimeGenerated desc

items.name: Drift, time-boxed deployments and worker recovery

content.title: Drift, time-boxed deployments and worker recovery
content.query:
ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL | where Log_s has "azure-terraform-mcp" | extend e = parse_json(Log_s) | where tostring(e.app) == "azure-terraform-mcp"
| where tostring(e.type) in ("drift", "ttl_notice", "ttl_reaped", "ttl_reap_failed", "operation_recovered") | where tostring(e.type) != "drift" or tobool(e.drifted) == true | project TimeGenerated, event = tostring(e.type), environment = tostring(e.environment), deployment = tostring(e.deployment), resources = tostring(e.drifted_resources), error = tostring(e.error), text = tostring(e.text) | order by TimeGenerated desc

items.name: Estimated monthly cost added per day (from plans that were created)

content.title: Estimated monthly cost added per day (from plans that were created)
content.query:
ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL | where Log_s has "azure-terraform-mcp" | extend e = parse_json(Log_s) | where tostring(e.app) == "azure-terraform-mcp"
| where tostring(e.type) == "plan" and tobool(e.has_changes) == true | summarize planned_delta_usd = sum(todouble(e.monthly_delta_usd)) by bin(TimeGenerated, 1d), environment = tostring(e.environment)

properties.displayName: [concat('Azure Terraform MCP (', parameters('prefix'), '): apply failed or was interrupted')]
properties.description: A Terraform apply failed or its worker stopped. The deployment may be partly changed: run a new plan.

allOf.query: ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL | where Log_s has "azure-terraform-mcp" | extend e = parse_json(Log_s) | where tostring(e.app) == "azure-terraform-mcp" | where tostring(e.type) == "operation" and tostring(e.kind) == "apply" and tostring(e.status) in ("failed", "interrupted")

properties.displayName: [concat('Azure Terraform MCP (', parameters('prefix'), '): an operation was recovered from a dead worker')]
properties.description: A replica died while running Terraform. Plans are retried; applies are marked interrupted.

allOf.query: ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL | where Log_s has "azure-terraform-mcp" | extend e = parse_json(Log_s) | where tostring(e.app) == "azure-terraform-mcp" | where tostring(e.type) == "operation_recovered"

properties.displayName: [concat('Azure Terraform MCP (', parameters('prefix'), '): many rejected sign-ins')]
properties.description: More than 10 requests were rejected by the server's own token validation in 15 minutes.

allOf.query: ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL | where Log_s has "azure-terraform-mcp" | extend e = parse_json(Log_s) | where tostring(e.app) == "azure-terraform-mcp" | where tostring(e.type) == "auth_rejected"

properties.displayName: [concat('Azure Terraform MCP (', parameters('prefix'), '): many denied tool calls')]
properties.description: More than 10 tool calls were denied (policy, approval, budget or disabled environment) in one hour.

allOf.query: ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL | where Log_s has "azure-terraform-mcp" | extend e = parse_json(Log_s) | where tostring(e.app) == "azure-terraform-mcp" | where tostring(e.type) == "audit" and tostring(e.outcome) == "denied"

properties.displayName: [concat('Azure Terraform MCP (', parameters('prefix'), '): change applied in an approval-controlled environment')]
properties.description: Informational: a plan was applied in an environment whose applies need approval. Check who planned, approved and applied.

allOf.query: ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL | where Log_s has "azure-terraform-mcp" | extend e = parse_json(Log_s) | where tostring(e.app) == "azure-terraform-mcp" | where tostring(e.type) == "apply" and isnotempty(tostring(e.approved_by))

properties.description: Azure no longer matches what was deployed for at least one deployment.

allOf.query: ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL | where Log_s has "azure-terraform-mcp" | extend e = parse_json(Log_s) | where tostring(e.app) == "azure-terraform-mcp" | where tostring(e.type) == "drift" and tobool(e.drifted) == true

properties.displayName: [concat('Azure Terraform MCP (', parameters('prefix'), '): a time-boxed deployment is about to be destroyed')]
properties.description: A time-boxed deployment reached its notice period. Extend it with extend_ttl or let it expire.

allOf.query: ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL | where Log_s has "azure-terraform-mcp" | extend e = parse_json(Log_s) | where tostring(e.app) == "azure-terraform-mcp" | where tostring(e.type) == "ttl_notice"

properties.displayName: [concat('Azure Terraform MCP (', parameters('prefix'), '): an expired deployment could not be destroyed')]
properties.description: The TTL reaper failed to destroy an expired deployment; it keeps costing money.

allOf.query: ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL | where Log_s has "azure-terraform-mcp" | extend e = parse_json(Log_s) | where tostring(e.app) == "azure-terraform-mcp" | where tostring(e.type) == "ttl_reap_failed"
